body.name: \(\chi_\varepsilon\)
body.def: A fixed annular cutoff around the pole of \(\varphi_{g_\star}\), equal to zero at torus distance at most \(\varepsilon\), equal to one from distance \(2\varepsilon\) through \(\delta_0/4\), and equal to zero from distance \(\delta_0/2\) onward, with transition derivatives of order \(m\) bounded by constants times \(\varepsilon^{-m}\) at the inner boundary.
